svg.title: ESP32-S3 Chromasic timing: physical waveform, bit fields, frame layout and differential link
svg.desc: Annotated timing diagram: Chromasic zero uses 0.6 microseconds high and 1.6 low, one uses 1.6 high and 0.6 low; each bit is 2.2 microseconds. Start code is thirteen ones then eight zeros, a node is 20-bit channel one, 20-bit channel two, 21-bit channel three. Frame has 6000 idle zeros, 21 start bits, 60 times 61 node bits and six flush node groups. GPIO18 is disabled by default; electrically different from the differential leader.
svg.text: Signal encoding / packet framing / frame timing / output electrical path
Safe firmware drives no GPIO. Shapes below model the code with CK_OUTPUT_ENABLED=1; electrical pinout and LED behavior remain unverified.
1 CHROMASIC BIT CELLS — GPIO18 logical output
RMT clock = 10 MHz (100 ns/tick) • 22 ticks per bit = 2.2 µs • 454,545 bits/s
0 = HIGH 0.6 µs (6 ticks) + LOW 1.6 µs (16 ticks)
1 = HIGH 1.6 µs (16 ticks) + LOW 0.6 µs (6 ticks)
2 START MARKER → ONE NODE → EXTRA FLUSH NODES
Each data word begins with a '1', sends 12 brightness bits LSB-first, then zero padding.
For each of 60 physical nodes: 20 + 20 + 21 = 61 bits. Then six all-zero data nodes = 366 bits.
The current fixed-white prototype sets channel 1 only; whether the hardware needs channel 2 is unresolved.
3 COMPLETE REPEATING FRAME — PROPORTIONAL TIME SCALE
Compiled prototype: 6,000 idle zeros + 21 start bits + 60 × 61 node bits + 6 × 61 flush bits = 10,047 bits
Frame period ≈ 22.103 ms • repetition ≈ 45.24 Hz • one 2.2 µs pulse per idle bit (not static LOW)
6,000 idle pulses and continuous DMA are implementation choices; zero gaps, underflow resistance, and receiver timing are unmeasured.
4 PHYSICAL SIGNAL PATH — NOT THE SAME VOLTAGES ON EVERY WIRE
NO CAN / UART / DMX frames. A/B polarity, 5V interface, leader pinout, and actual LED response must be verified.
Basis: Glen Akins (2019), Reverse Engineering the iColor Flex Protocol; implementation: main/chromasic_protocol.[ch] + main/main.c.
This is generated/illustrative protocol documentation, not an oscilloscope capture or certification of Color Kinetics eW Flex Compact HE compatibility.
